title: ATLAS_Tool_Calling_Schemas
description: Deterministic JSON Schemas for the 19 tools supported by ATLAS-3B

tools.name: wake_pc
tools.description: Broadcasts a Wake-on-LAN magic packet to power on a target workstation.

tools.name: sleep_pc
tools.description: Triggers graceful ACPI S3 sleep state on the target workstation.

tools.name: spotify_dj
tools.description: Controls Spotify playback, tracks, search queries, playlists, and volume.

tools.name: mute_pc_mic
tools.description: Instantly mutes the hardware/system microphone on the PC for privacy.

tools.name: pc_window_control
tools.description: Minimizes, maximizes, restores, or snaps active application windows on PC.

tools.name: kill_process
tools.description: Gracefully terminates or force-kills a process by name or PID.

tools.name: capture_screen
tools.description: Captures a full or region screenshot of the active PC screen.

tools.name: clipboard_teleport
tools.description: Copies text, URLs, or OCR snippets across devices directly into the PC clipboard.

tools.name: snap_camera
tools.description: Triggers phone or connected IoT camera to snap a high-resolution photo for OCR or vision inspection.

tools.name: save_memory
tools.description: Persists structured knowledge, preferences, or configuration facts into SQLite memory.

tools.name: query_memory
tools.description: Retrieves semantic facts, past context, or saved credentials from SQLite memory.

tools.name: delete_memory
tools.description: Removes obsolete facts or records from SQLite memory.

tools.name: check_status
tools.description: Checks health metrics (battery, thermals, CPU load, network latency, daemons).

tools.name: firewall_filter
tools.description: Adds or removes firewall rules and blocks unauthorized IP addresses.

tools.name: daily_recap
tools.description: Generates a comprehensive summary of system events, completed tasks, and telemetry.

tools.name: delegate_to_cloud
tools.description: Escalates compute-intensive jobs (heavy reasoning, large batch jobs) to an on-demand cloud GPU worker.

tools.name: call_custom_plugin
tools.description: Dispatches arguments to user-defined scripts located in the plugins directory.

tools.name: none
tools.description: Used when the model responds purely conversationally without needing to call any external tool.
